# Your next discovery starts here

Explore the world, uncover ancient fossils, and awaken a companion of your own. This is the player wiki for **Spectrobes Reforged 0.5.1-alpha**, for **Minecraft 1.21.1 with NeoForge**.

> **An alpha with a growing adventure.** This guide describes the bundled code and data. Custom modpacks and datapacks can change the experience. Planned features are marked explicitly.

## Begin your journey

1. [Install the mod and its dependencies](getting-started.md).
2. [Find fossil ores in the right biomes](fossils.md).
3. [Power an incubator and awaken a supported fossil](awakening.md).
4. [Manage your companion in the Prizmod](prizmod.md).
5. [Scan for buried discoveries](scanning.md) and [feed minerals](minerals.md).

**Before you start:** the bundled mod does not yet include crafting recipes for the incubator or Prizmod. For a first test, use Creative mode or ask your server administrator for these items. See [getting started](getting-started.md#alpha-access-to-essential-items).

## Field reference

- [Spectrobe roster](spectrobes.md): supported species, base stats, caps, and scanning radius.
- [Minerals and recipes](minerals.md): exact stat changes, Chroma, ore heights, and crafting.
- [Krawl](krawl.md): current enemies and how to test them.
- [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md): missing companions, awakening issues, and useful bug reports.
- [Admin commands](commands.md): tools for testing and recovery.

## What works today?

| System | Current state |
| --- | --- |
| Fossil and mineral ores | Biome-based fossil generation; mineral generation in the Overworld |
| Awakening | Redstone-powered incubator, sound input, three color variants |
| Collection | Persistent storage, one child companion slot, six team slots |
| Companion | Following and an underground scan |
| Feeding | HP, attack and defense adjustments; Chroma recoloring |
| Krawl | JSON definitions, animated entities and spawn eggs |
| Evolution | Targets and mineral thresholds exist; no completed evolution interaction |
| Team combat | Slots and stats exist; a complete deployment/battle loop is not implemented |
| Analysis and cleaning | Not implemented |

## Stay connected

[Download on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/spectrobes-reforged) · [Source and issues](https://github.com/jvprz/SpectrobesReforged) · [Join Discord](https://discord.gg/7QkScUWBe9)

The mod supports English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese. This first edition of the wiki is in English.
pages.getting-started:
# Getting started

## Requirements

| Component | Current requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Minecraft | 1.21.1 |
| Loader | NeoForge 21.1.219 or newer for Minecraft 1.21.1 |
| GeckoLib | 4.8.3 or newer for NeoForge 1.21.1 |
| Java | 21 |

These requirements describe 0.5.1-alpha. Match every download to **Minecraft 1.21.1 and NeoForge**; older mod releases have different requirements.

## Install

1. Create a Minecraft 1.21.1 instance with NeoForge.
2. Download Spectrobes Reforged from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/spectrobes-reforged).
3. Install the matching GeckoLib dependency. A launcher may offer to install it automatically.
4. For a manual installation, place the mod and GeckoLib JAR files in that instance’s `mods` folder.
5. Launch the NeoForge profile and create a test world.

Do not leave multiple versions of Spectrobes Reforged in the same instance. Back up existing worlds before updating an alpha mod.

## Alpha access to essential items

The bundled recipes currently cover **six mineral combinations**. There is no bundled incubator or Prizmod crafting recipe yet. Obtain them from the Creative inventory, ask an administrator, or use commands with cheats/operator permission:

```text
/give @s spectrobesreforged:incubator
/give @s spectrobesreforged:white_prizmod
/give @s spectrobesreforged:komainu_fossil
```

The last command gives a known supported fossil for your first awakening. These are testing instructions, not a finished survival progression. A modpack may supply its own recipes.

## Your first companion

1. Place the incubator with two horizontal spaces available.
2. Supply redstone power, for example from a nearby powered lever.
3. Open it, insert the Komainu fossil, and click its start button.
4. Keep it powered for about 10 seconds. Sounds affect color, not whether the timer advances.
5. Hold the Prizmod and use it to inspect the new entry.

If your child slot was empty, the awakened entry goes there; otherwise it goes into storage. The companion recovery check normally brings a child-slot Spectrobe into the world shortly afterward.

Continue with [awakening](awakening.md) for color control and [Prizmod management](prizmod.md).

## Language and controls

Change the language in Minecraft’s language settings. Available translations are English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese.

The default **Scan** key is **R**, under the Spectrobes Reforged controls category. Rebind it if another mod uses the same key.

## Multiplayer scope

The implementation includes player-owned collection data and network messages. A dedicated-server compatibility test is not part of this documentation review. Test your server/modpack combination before using an important world.
pages.fossils:
# Fossils and exploration

Fossil ores generate underground in selected Overworld biomes. Use an **iron pickaxe or better**: the bundled mining tags require an iron-tier tool.

## Where to look

| Element | Biome group | Stone variant height | Deepslate variant height |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Corona | Hot | Y 0 to 72 | Y -64 to -1 |
| Aurora | Temperate | Y 0 to 72 | Y -64 to -1 |
| Flash | Cold | Y 0 to 72 | Y -64 to -1 |

These are configured placement ranges, not guaranteed ore locations: terrain and replaceable stone also affect the result. Explore newly generated chunks when adding the mod to an existing world.

| Element | Included biomes |
| --- | --- |
| Corona | Desert, Savanna, Savanna Plateau, Badlands, Wooded Badlands, Eroded Badlands, Jungle, Sparse Jungle |
| Aurora | Plains, Sunflower Plains, Forest, Birch Forest, Dark Forest, Meadow, Flower Forest |
| Flash | Snowy Plains, Snowy Taiga, Taiga, Grove, Snowy Slopes, Frozen Peaks, Jagged Peaks, Ice Spikes |

## Mining and drops

Without Silk Touch, a fossil ore drops one of its element’s fossil items. The entries within each bundled element pool have equal weight. With Silk Touch, the block drops its ore block instead.

| Ore element | Possible fossil items |
| --- | --- |
| Corona | Vilipod (`vilar_fossil`), Inkapod (`inkana_fossil`), Dongopod (`dongor_fossil`), Komapod (`komainu_fossil`), Zozapod (`zoza_fossil`), Danapod (`danawa_fossil`), Tenkropod (`tenkro_fossil`), Mesapod (`mesa_fossil`) |
| Aurora | Segupod (`segu_fossil`), Spipod (`spiko_fossil`), Bartopod (`bartor_fossil`), Grilpod (`grilda_fossil`), Gejipod (`gejio_fossil`), Kubapod (`kubaku_fossil`), Masepod (`masetto_fossil`) |
| Flash | Harupod (`harumi_fossil`), Nagupod (`nagu_fossil`), Aopod (`aoi_fossil`), Shapod (`shakin_fossil`), Kasupod (`kasumi_fossil`), Samupod (`samukabu_fossil`), Mossapod (`mossari_fossil`) |

## Which fossils can awaken?

**Only six species currently have bundled species definitions:** Inkana, Komainu, Segu, Shakin, Spiko, and Vilar. Other fossil items can drop and be collected, but cannot currently complete awakening with the default species data.

If a definition is missing, the incubator reports the issue and aborts without consuming the fossil. See the [supported roster](spectrobes.md).

## Excavation status

The current discovery interaction is Minecraft ore mining. A separate fossil-cleaning or excavation minigame is not implemented. Analysis and purification belong to the future progression.

Once you have a supported fossil, continue to [the incubator](awakening.md).
pages.awakening:
# Incubator and awakening

The incubator turns a supported fossil into a collection entry. It uses **redstone power** and listens to nearby Minecraft game events and playing jukeboxes.

## Set up the machine

1. Obtain an incubator from the Creative inventory or an administrator; there is no bundled recipe yet.
2. Leave two adjacent horizontal spaces free. The second half is placed to the left relative to your facing direction.
3. Supply a redstone signal to either half.
4. Use the powered machine to open its interface.

The current machine does not use an FE energy storage or fuel inventory. A “no power” message means it is not receiving redstone power.

## Awaken a fossil

1. Put a supported fossil in the single input slot.
2. Click the start button.
3. Keep the incubator powered while progress advances for **200 ticks**, about **10 seconds at 20 TPS**.
4. Keep the starting player online so delivery can complete.

The input cannot be picked up during awakening. Losing power pauses progress. At completion, the result is assigned to the player who started the process. If that player is offline, the full progress waits for delivery to be retried.

The fossil is consumed only after the collection entry is successfully created. A short transfer effect then plays for about 1.5 seconds. An empty child slot receives the new entry first; if occupied, the result goes into storage.

## Control the color

The machine’s captured sound frequency is clamped to **0–16**. The value at the **final awakening tick** determines the result:

| Final captured frequency | Color variant |
| --- | --- |
| 0–5 | 0: original colors |
| 6–10 | 1 |
| 11–16 | 2 |

Silence can produce variant 0; sound is not required for the progress timer to run. This is not microphone input: speaking into a real microphone does not drive the machine.

Nearby game-event sounds produce short impulses. A playing jukebox within **16 blocks** provides a changing frequency influenced by song time and distance. The machine uses the stronger of its current impulse and jukebox values, rather than averaging the full process. Watch the in-game meter near completion.

Chroma minerals can change the variant later; see [minerals](minerals.md#chroma).

## If awakening fails

- **No power:** check the redstone signal at either half.
- **Start unavailable:** insert a fossil and ensure a process is not already active.
- **Species data missing:** use one of the [six supported fossils](spectrobes.md).
- **Full progress but no delivery:** the player who started awakening must be online; the machine must remain loaded and powered.
- **Entry exists but no creature:** check the child slot and HP in the [Prizmod](prizmod.md).
pages.prizmod:
# Prizmod and companions

Hold any Prizmod variant and **use/right-click** it to open your collection. All color variants access the same player-owned data; they are not separate boxes.

## Collection areas

| Area | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Storage / box | Holds your collection entries; the data model has no fixed capacity |
| Child / baby slot | One Child Spectrobe used as the active following companion |
| Team | Six slots accepting Adult or Evolved entries |

Use the interface’s drag-and-drop controls to move entries between compatible areas. Child entries cannot be placed in team slots; Adult and Evolved entries cannot be placed in the child slot. Swaps must satisfy both slots’ stage rules.

## Bringing a companion out

Place a Child entry with HP remaining into the child slot. Changing this slot refreshes the following entity. The companion follows you and pauses when you trigger a scan.

An active recovery check looks for your companion approximately once per second. Dimension changes and respawn also have refresh handling. A Prizmod companion does not travel through a portal as an independent entity; the owner’s refresh handling manages its return.

This is recovery logic, not a guarantee against every alpha issue. If it does not return, see [troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md).

## Reading an entry

Hover an entry to see species, stage, level, color variant, HP, attack, defense, stat bonuses and evolution mineral progress. Stat caps come from the species definition.

**“READY” means a mineral threshold was reached. It does not currently provide an evolution action.** The bundled roster contains Child species only; the complete growth, adult-team deployment and battle loop is still in development.

## Health and ownership

Companion damage is reflected in the saved entry. Entries with no HP remaining are not spawned by the companion manager. The admin [healing command](commands.md) can restore equipped entries during testing.

Minerals are applied by using them on a living Spectrobe that belongs to you and is linked to your Prizmod entry. A separately summoned creature is not necessarily a collection-linked companion.

## Persistence

Collection entries, team slots and the child slot are serialized as player data. Back up the entire world before updating; replacing a JAR is not a substitute for a world backup.

Next: [use the scanner](scanning.md) or [improve stats with minerals](minerals.md).
pages.scanning:
# Companion scanner

Your active child companion can search for buried fossil and mineral ores.

## Start a scan

1. Equip a Child Spectrobe in the Prizmod’s child slot and wait for it to appear.
2. Stand near your companion.
3. Press **R** by default, or your rebound **Scan** key.
4. Watch the circular sweep, listen for discovery sounds, and look for colored particle hints.

The companion pauses for **66 ticks**, about **3.3 seconds at normal tick rate**. The ring opens over its first 6 ticks. A scan is temporary; pressing the key triggers the range-pause behavior again.

## Range and targets

The current horizontal radius is **twice the species’ configured range value**, centered on the companion, not the player. The scan searches downward from its block position by up to **64 blocks**.

| Companions | Horizontal radius |
| --- | --- |
| Inkana, Komainu, Shakin, Spiko | 6 blocks |
| Segu, Vilar | 8 blocks |

- **Orange hints:** fossil ore.
- **Light blue hints:** mineral ore.
- The result list is limited to **12 ore positions**, not every deposit in the area.
- Only loaded world data is searched.

Search work is spread across ticks. Results are not necessarily immediate. Discovery hints appear at a suitable air position above a detected ore; terrain and caves can affect where you see them. The scanner does not mine blocks for you.

## No result?

Check the key binding, child slot and companion HP first. Move closer to the terrain you want to scan and try again. A deposit can be outside the horizontal radius, deeper than the search depth, or outside currently available client world data.
pages.spectrobes:
# Spectrobe roster

These are the **six species with bundled definitions** in 0.5.1-alpha. All start as Child entries. Numbers below come directly from the species JSON files when the wiki is built.

## Stats and scan radius

Each stat cell shows **base → cap**. The scan column shows the actual horizontal radius used by the current scanner.

| Species | Element | HP | Attack | Defense | Scan radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inkana | Corona | 40 → 75 | 70 → 125 | 95 → 175 | 6 blocks |
| Komainu | Corona | 120 → 200 | 65 → 125 | 55 → 105 | 6 blocks |
| Segu | Aurora | 50 → 50 | 50 → 100 | 90 → 160 | 8 blocks |
| Shakin | Flash | 72 → 125 | 65 → 145 | 40 → 115 | 6 blocks |
| Spiko | Aurora | 65 → 140 | 75 → 175 | 30 → 95 | 6 blocks |
| Vilar | Corona | 70 → 125 | 60 → 115 | 100 → 180 | 8 blocks |

Minerals can improve stats up to the listed caps. For example, Segu’s HP base and cap are both 50, so an HP-only mineral cannot increase that stat.

## Evolution data: not yet playable

| Child | Configured target | Mineral threshold | Target definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inkana | Inkanapa | 4 | Not bundled |
| Komainu | Komanoto | 5 | Not bundled |
| Segu | Segulos | 3 | Not bundled |
| Shakin | Shakor | 4 | Not bundled |
| Spiko | Spikan | 3 | Not bundled |
| Vilar | Vilamasta | 7 | Not bundled |

These targets and thresholds are data for a developing system. The destination species do not have bundled definitions, and feeding minerals does not currently trigger a transformation. A “READY” tooltip is not evidence that evolution is available.

## Other fossils

More fossil items exist than awakenable species. Collecting a fossil is not a promise that its species is ready. See the [fossil drop pools](fossils.md#mining-and-drops) for the distinction.
pages.minerals:
# Minerals and recipes

Minerals modify a linked companion’s HP, attack and defense. Hold a mineral and use it on **your own living Prizmod companion**.

## Feeding rules

- Stat changes are clamped between the species’ base and maximum values.
- A trade-off mineral can lower one stat while raising another, but not below the species base.
- A successful stat-changing feeding increments the saved mineral counter.
- In Survival, one item is consumed after a successful change. Creative does not consume it.
- If no stat changes, the mineral is not consumed and the counter does not advance.
- HP minerals adjust current HP by the change in maximum HP; they are not a separate full-heal system.

The table lists the configured changes **before clamping**. `MAX` sets that stat to the species cap.

| Mineral | Item ID | HP | Attack | Defense |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Power C | `power_c` | +0 | +8 | +0 |
| Power B | `power_b` | +0 | +16 | +0 |
| Defense C | `defense_c` | +0 | +0 | +8 |
| Defense B | `defense_b` | +0 | +0 | +16 |
| Health C | `health_c` | +8 | +0 | +0 |
| Health B | `health_b` | +16 | +0 | +0 |
| Power A | `power_a` | +0 | +24 | +0 |
| Power A+ | `power_a_plus` | +0 | +32 | +0 |
| Defense A | `defense_a` | +0 | +0 | +24 |
| Defense A+ | `defense_a_plus` | +0 | +0 | +32 |
| Health A | `health_a` | +24 | +0 | +0 |
| Health A+ | `health_a_plus` | +32 | +0 | +0 |
| Agate | `agate` | +0 | +8 | +8 |
| Lazuli | `lazuli` | +0 | +16 | +16 |
| Jade | `jade` | +8 | +8 | +0 |
| Amber | `amber` | +16 | +16 | +0 |
| Fluorite | `fluorite` | +8 | +0 | +8 |
| Coral | `coral` | +16 | +0 | +16 |
| Graphite | `graphite` | +0 | +30 | -8 |
| Garnet | `garnet` | +0 | -8 | +30 |
| Onyx | `onyx` | +0 | +40 | -16 |
| Topaz | `topaz` | +0 | -16 | +40 |
| Zircon | `zircon` | -8 | +30 | +0 |
| Opal | `opal` | +30 | -8 | +0 |
| Cobalt | `cobalt` | -16 | +40 | +0 |
| Citrine | `citrine` | +40 | -16 | +0 |
| Sylvite | `sylvite` | -8 | +0 | +30 |
| Spinal | `spinal` | +30 | +0 | -8 |
| Azurite | `azurite` | -16 | +0 | +40 |
| Quartz | `quartz` | +40 | +0 | -16 |
| Platinum | `platinum` | +5 | +5 | +5 |
| Pearl | `pearl` | +12 | +12 | +12 |
| Uranium | `uranium` | -16 | MAX | -16 |
| Titanium | `titanium` | -16 | -16 | MAX |
| Chrome | `chrome` | MAX | -16 | -16 |
| Sapphire | `sapphire` | +24 | +24 | +24 |
| Emerald | `emerald` | +36 | +36 | +36 |
| Ruby | `ruby` | +50 | +50 | +50 |
| Diamond | `diamond` | +0 | +0 | +0 |
| Gold | `gold` | -15 | -15 | -15 |
| Evolve | `evolve` | +0 | +0 | +0 |

## Special items and current limits

**Diamond** and **Evolve** are registered as minerals with zero stat deltas. Despite their descriptive flavor text, the current feeding implementation gives them no effect: they do not consume an item or evolve a Spectrobe. **Gold** reduces all three stats by 15, subject to the base-stat floor.

The tooltip’s evolution progress is preparatory data. See [evolution status](spectrobes.md#evolution-data-not-yet-playable).

## Chroma

Use Chroma on a Spectrobe you own:

| Item ID | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `chroma_0` | Restore color variant 0 |
| `chroma_1` | Apply color variant 1 |
| `chroma_2` | Apply color variant 2 |

All three currently display as **Chroma**; their tooltips identify the effect. A successful change consumes one outside Creative. If the variant already matches, it is not consumed. When the entity is linked to your collection, a successful color change also increments its mineral counter.

## Ore generation

Use an iron pickaxe or better. Mineral features are added to the Overworld biome tag.

| Tier | Y range | Non-Silk-Touch drops |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C | -64 to -16 | Power C, Defense C, Health C |
| B | -16 to 32 | Power B, Defense B, Health B |
| A | 32 to 80 | Power A, Defense A, Health A |
| A+ | 64 to 160 | Power A+, Defense A+, Health A+ |

The default biome modifier adds the four named mineral features above. Deepslate mineral blocks are registered, but no separate deepslate mineral placed features are bundled. Silk Touch gives the ore block; otherwise the loot table chooses an item from the tier’s drop pool.

## Crafting recipes

The following are the **six bundled recipes**, all shapeless and producing one item:

| Result | Ingredients |
| --- | --- |
| Agate | Power C + Defense C |
| Amber | Power B + Health B |
| Coral | Defense B + Health B |
| Fluorite | Defense C + Health C |
| Jade | Power C + Health C |
| Lazuli | Power B + Defense B |

There are no bundled crafting recipes for Chroma, the incubator or the Prizmod. Registered items without a recipe or documented drop route may need Creative or administrator access in this alpha.
pages.krawl:
# Krawl enemies

The current mod includes **Blova, Viblova, and Blovant** definitions with custom models, sounds and melee behavior. They can be created using their registered spawn eggs.

## Current definitions

| Krawl | Element | Rank | HP | Attack | Armor |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Blova | Flash | Basic | 20 | 4 | 2 |
| Blovant | Corona | Basic | 20 | 4 | 2 |
| Viblova | Aurora | Basic | 20 | 4 | 2 |

These are the configured entity attributes, not a guarantee of final combat damage after every armor or gameplay modifier.

## Try them in a test world

Use the Creative inventory’s spawn-egg tab, or give yourself the eggs with operator permission:

```text
/give @s spectrobesreforged:blova_spawn_egg
/give @s spectrobesreforged:viblova_spawn_egg
/give @s spectrobesreforged:blovant_spawn_egg
```

Use an egg on a block to create that Krawl. Test away from an important build or companion.

## Natural spawns and nests

Krawl definitions include spawn-related fields, but the reviewed code does not register a natural-spawn biome integration for these enemies. Do not assume a configured weight or light range means they will appear naturally. Use eggs for reproducible testing.

Krawl nests and corrupted areas are not implemented in the bundled content. A complete Spectrobe team combat loop is also still in development.
pages.commands:
# Admin commands

The mod registers two testing commands. Both require **permission level 2** and a player command source, so run them as an operator or in a cheats-enabled world rather than directly from the server console.

## Give a Spectrobe entry

```text
/givespectrobe <species> [color]
```

Creates a level-1 entry in **storage**, with base stats and full HP. It does not put it into the child slot automatically. The optional color is **0, 1, or 2**, defaulting to 0. Species suggestions come from loaded definitions.

```text
/givespectrobe komainu
/givespectrobe segu 2
```

Open the Prizmod and move the entry into the child slot to use it as a companion.

## Heal equipped entries

```text
/spectrobehealth
```

Restores the saved current HP of the **six team slots and the child slot** to their respective maximum HP. It does not heal every entry in storage. The command updates collection data and sends a snapshot; if a living entity still shows old health, return the entry to storage and re-equip it to recreate it from saved data.

## Vanilla item commands for alpha testing

```text
/give @s spectrobesreforged:incubator
/give @s spectrobesreforged:white_prizmod
/give @s spectrobesreforged:komainu_fossil
```

These are vanilla `/give` examples, not additional mod commands. There is no completed evolution command in the registered command set.
pages.troubleshooting:
# Troubleshooting

## The game will not start

Check Minecraft 1.21.1, the NeoForge version, Java 21, and the **NeoForge 1.21.1 build of GeckoLib**. Remove duplicate mod versions. Reproduce in a clean test instance before attributing an issue to a mod interaction.

## I cannot craft the incubator or Prizmod

Their recipes are not included in the current alpha. Use [Creative or administrator access](getting-started.md#alpha-access-to-essential-items). Do not search for an undocumented crafting pattern.

## The incubator has no power

It requires a redstone signal at either half, not an FE energy cable or fuel. Keep both halves intact and the area loaded.

## My fossil cannot awaken

Check that it belongs to [a supported species](spectrobes.md). Many fossil items exist without loaded species data. Missing-species failures should leave the fossil unconsumed.

## The companion is missing

1. Open the Prizmod and check the child slot.
2. Check that the entry is a Child and has HP remaining.
3. Wait briefly for recovery handling.
4. If necessary, move it to storage and back to refresh it.
5. For an entry at zero HP, ask an administrator about `/spectrobehealth`.

Do not use `/givespectrobe` as the first recovery step: it creates a new entry rather than recovering the existing one.

## The scanner does nothing

Check the **Scan** binding under Spectrobes Reforged; its default is **R**. Resolve any key conflicts, equip a healthy child companion, and stand near it. See [scan limits](scanning.md#range-and-targets).

## A mineral has no effect

You must own the living target and it must be linked to a collection entry. Its stats may already be capped, or a negative effect may already be at the base-stat floor. Diamond and Evolve currently have no stat effect. Reopen the Prizmod to refresh its displayed data if needed.

## Evolution says READY but nothing happens

That indicator only compares minerals fed with a configured threshold. The transformation interaction and destination species are not implemented yet.

## Krawl are not spawning naturally

Use the Creative spawn eggs. Spawn fields in their definitions are not a completed natural-spawn system.

## Report an issue

Post in **#bug-reports** on [Discord](https://discord.gg/7QkScUWBe9) or open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/jvprz/SpectrobesReforged/issues). Include:

- Mod, Minecraft, NeoForge and GeckoLib versions.
- Single-player or server; relevant other mods or datapacks.
- Exact steps, expected result, and actual result.
- Screenshots and relevant `latest.log` or crash-report excerpts.

Review logs before sharing: remove personal information, server addresses, private tokens and webhook URLs. Always keep a world backup before testing updates.
pages.about:
# About this wiki

This wiki documents **0.5.1-alpha** from the local source tree. It is a source-based guide, not a claim that every described feature has been tested across all servers and modpacks.

The website builds directly from Markdown in `docs/`. Reference tables are generated from the bundled species, recipes, biome tags, loot tables and mineral registrations. A version change in `gradle.properties` updates the displayed version on the next build.

## Evidence behind the guides

| Guide | Main implementation or data |
| --- | --- |
| Installation | `gradle.properties`, `META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml` |
| Fossils | Biome modifiers, biome tags, placed features, fossil block loot tables |
| Awakening | `IncubatorBlock`, `IncubatorBlockEntity`, `IncubatorMenu`, `IncubatorMusic` |
| Collection | `PrizmodData`, `PrizmodItem`, `C2SMoveSpectrobe`, `SpectrobeManager` |
| Companion | Follow and portal guards; Spectrobe goals and spawn handling |
| Scanning | `ModKeybinds`, scan packet handler, `SpectrobeRangeRenderer`, `FossilScan` |
| Minerals | `ModItems`, `MineralItem`, `ChromaMineralItem`, recipe and loot JSON |
| Krawl | Krawl JSON, factory, entity, spawn eggs and entity registration |
| Commands | `ModCommands` |

## Help keep the guide accurate

Report an incorrect instruction or propose a documentation change on [GitHub](https://github.com/jvprz/SpectrobesReforged). Include the version you tested. A feature described by a JSON field or flavor text is not marked playable unless the surrounding implementation supports it.

This is a fan-made project. Spectrobes Reforged is not an official Minecraft or Spectrobes product.
